# Module:option

<div class="api-badges"><span class="api-badge api-badge--since">since 1.6.0</span></div>

Get / Set one module option.

```lua
local value = module:option(name)
```

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `name` | string | yes | , value (integer, optional) |

## Returns

value (integer)

## Examples

```lua title="From the official Ethos documentation"
module.option("Disable channel mapping", 0x01000000)
```
